description: Twill extends TypeScript with Swift-inspired syntax: trailing closures, guards, defer and checked switch expressions. Compiles to ordinary JavaScript.
name: twill-workspace

scripts.check: pnpm verify:release && pnpm build && pnpm verify:skills && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:examples && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test:package && pnpm --filter @swiftuijs/twill test:size && pnpm editor:package
scripts.editor:build: pnpm --filter twill... run build && pnpm --filter twill verify
scripts.package:tooling: pnpm --filter @swiftuijs/twill-formatter pack --out swiftuijs-twill-formatter-%v.tgz && pnpm --filter @swiftuijs/twill-linter pack --out swiftuijs-twill-linter-%v.tgz && pnpm --filter @swiftuijs/twill-export pack --out swiftuijs-twill-export-%v.tgz && pnpm --filter @swiftuijs/twill-highlight pack --out swiftuijs-twill-highlight-%v.tgz && pnpm --filter @swiftuijs/twill-runtime pack --out swiftuijs-twill-runtime-%v.tgz
scripts.test:tooling: pnpm package:core && pnpm package:tooling && pnpm --filter @swiftuijs/twill-formatter --filter @swiftuijs/twill-linter --filter @swiftuijs/twill-export --filter @swiftuijs/twill-highlight --filter @swiftuijs/twill-runtime run test:package
scripts.test:packed: node packages/twill/tests/consumer.mjs --packed && node packages/formatter/tests/consumer.mjs && node packages/linter/tests/consumer.mjs && node packages/export/tests/consumer.mjs && node packages/highlight/tests/consumer.mjs && node packages/runtime/tests/consumer.mjs
scripts.deps:check: pnpm audit --audit-level moderate && pnpm peers check
